description: This file defines the LoanUndoReAmortizationCommandHandler class, which handles the undo re-amortization command for loan accounts in the Fineract system. It processes commands to revert amortization changes on loans, utilizing services for re-amortization and error handling.

classes.name: LoanUndoReAmortizationCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling the undo re-amortization command for loans, implementing command processing logic and error handling.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the undo re-amortization command, invoking the service to perform the undo operation and handling failures appropriately.
